gate.text: Problem, target user and the job they hire the product for are written down in docs/research.md
At least 3 existing alternatives (including 'do nothing' / spreadsheets) compared, with sources
At least one piece of evidence of real demand (quotes, threads, search volume, interviews), not just reasoning
Top risks and unknowns listed, each with a cheap way to test it
A go / pivot / stop recommendation is recorded and the user has confirmed it
docs/system-design.md exists and the user has read every line
Tenancy model (individual / team / organisation) is written down explicitly
An out-of-scope section exists
The design was reviewed by a skeptical reviewer pass and the findings were resolved or accepted
Every box in the architecture diagram can be explained by the user
Every dependency in the manifest has a stated reason
Business logic lives in a dedicated layer, not in UI or route files
CLAUDE.md (and AGENTS.md if used) carries stack, rules, commands and decision pointers
Scaffold runs: dev server starts and /api/health responds
Every schema change is a migration file in version control
Every tenant-owned table carries organization_id and every query on it is scoped
A user of Org A requesting an Org B resource by ID is refused (404) - shown by test output
Uploaded files are private by default and downloads are authorised
A backup was actually restored into a separate database at least once
Auth uses a proven provider/library; no custom password hashing code exists
A single central can(user, action, resource) function is used by every endpoint
Authorisation tests are generated from the permissions matrix (401 / 403 / 404 / allowed)
Garbage input returns a clean 400 in the standard error format, never a stack trace
Replaying every webhook event twice creates no duplicates (skip with reason if no payments)
Any request over ~1s has a reason or has been moved to a background job
Design tokens and base components exist, with a /design page showing every component in every state
Every data screen handles loading, empty, error and success states
With the network off, every screen shows a sensible error
The whole app is usable with only a keyboard
An automated accessibility check (e.g. axe) runs in the test suite
The app was opened on a real phone (or 375px emulation) and works
Client bundle was searched for keys, secrets and private URLs; none found
.gitignore, pre-commit secret scan and commit convention are in place; git history scanned for secrets
A PR with a deliberately failing test is blocked by CI
PRs get previews; main deploys to staging; production needs approval
Migrations run during deploy before new code goes live, and a failed migration fails the deploy
A rollback was performed once on purpose and documented
Signup, login, core workflow, billing and invite flows have end-to-end tests
Deliberately breaking a line of business logic makes at least one test fail
Every skipped test (.skip, xit, mark.skip) has a written reason
Staging and production use different databases and API keys
Removing a required env variable makes the app refuse to start with a clear message
Production backups are enabled and billing alerts are set on every provider
docs/security/threat-model.md exists with assets, entry points and mitigations
Security review was run by a fresh session or reviewer subagent, not the code's author; findings triaged
Script-injection payloads pasted into every text field execute nothing
Dependency audit done and automated update PRs configured
Login, signup and expensive endpoints are rate limited with a shared store; 20 rapid logins get blocked
Rate limits keep working after a redeploy
'Wrong password' and 'no such user' return the same message
Paid-API usage has quotas and a hard spending cap (skip with reason if none)
Every tenant-data cache key includes organization_id; authenticated responses are never cached at a shared layer
Test proves two orgs never receive each other's cached data and writes invalidate the cache
Structured JSON logs with request ID, user_id and organization_id; one request traceable end to end
Searching the logs for 'password' and token values returns nothing
A staging error appears in the tracker with a readable stack trace within a minute
No empty or over-broad catch blocks remain
/api/health checks DB, cache and job system; a lightweight liveness endpoint exists
Stopping the staging database produces an alert within the defined time
Every alert links to a runbook
Status page and incident runbook exist
Terms of service and privacy policy are published
Every claim in the promo copy matches something the product really does
Promo video(s) rendered and played back end to end by the user
Licences for fonts, music, sound effects and footage are checked and recorded
Pre-launch checklist in hs-launch/references/prelaunch.md is fully ticked or each gap is waived with a reason
A load test produced real p50/p95/p99 and error-rate numbers
Two backend instances run side by side with nothing breaking
Every optimisation has before/after numbers
Monthly cost modelled at 10x and 100x users
